constraints.description: Static single-page front end (React + Vite + TypeScript, Tailwind) served as static assets via nginx/Docker; no application backend server is maintained.
Contact form submissions are delivered through a third-party form-to-email service (Web3Forms); there is no owned database or server-side storage of leads.
No real secret values may be committed. Third-party keys must be referenced by environment-variable name only, and must not be hard-coded in source.
The experience is animation-heavy (video hero, scroll-scrubbed canvas sequences, particle canvases) and must remain smooth and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Branding and cinematic look-and-feel must be preserved; the site is the primary top-of-funnel asset for the Logia Initiative.
